$comment: Sandbox images pinned by digest (09 4.4). Written by .github/workflows/images.yml through scripts/images.py lock: every docker/<dir>/Dockerfile is built for linux/amd64, scanned (Trivy Critical blocks), pushed to private ghcr.io/soken-ltd/<dir>; entries match by repository, so aliases get the same digest. Runtime pulls repository@digest only (sandbox.profile.locked_image). A zero digest = not built yet: callers fail closed.

aptos-prove.note: docker/aptos-prove (plan v4 07 prover integration). Extends aptos-build with z3 (apt, Debian bookworm 4.8.17) and Boogie 3.4.3 (dotnet global tool). Zero digest = not built; prove_image_for('aptos') fails closed until the x86 stand builds and pins the digest. Build: docker build -f docker/aptos-prove/Dockerfile -t ghcr.io/soken-ltd/aptos-prove:aptos-cli-v9.6.0-prove .

aptos-build.note: docker/aptos-build (plan v4 07 3, 7.2). Release zip sha256-verified; framework at the tag commit. Licence U-21 (warning in development). Digest placeholder until the CI push.

evm-analyze.note: Pre-CI digest (no forge). LOCAL arm64 build verified 2026-10-14: forge sha256 gate passes (foundry_v1.8.5_linux_arm64.tar.gz: OK, forge Version 1.8.5). Replace digest after CI push with: docker inspect --format='{{index .RepoDigests 0}}' ghcr.io/soken-ltd/evm-analyze:<tag>. B4 enabled when CI digest is recorded.

git-fetch.note: soken-fetch: git materializer (09 5.2, sandbox/git_materializer.py) on Debian trixie (git 2.47, GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH).

hyperevm-analyze.note: Extends evm-analyze with HL-* Slither detectors (slither_plugins, plan-v4 05 8.2). Digest placeholder; replace after CI build.

smokescreen.note: Family egress proxy (09 4.3), runs under runc as infra, not a sandbox step. Config and ACL from soken_review.sandbox.egress (limits.yaml egress).

soken-render.note: 08 3.2 render sandbox (docker/soken-render/Dockerfile, root context). Digest placeholder until the CI push; render_image() fails closed while unpinned (SOKEN_IMAGE_SOKEN_RENDER for local images). chrome-headless-shell zip sha256 39dcb8c4... pinned in the Dockerfile.

solana-analyze.note: Analysis stage of docker/solana-build/Dockerfile (target analyze on 4.3.0: clippy + cargo-audit + Python), published by images.yml. Tag carries -analyze: the bare <version> tags of this repository are the per-version build images that solana-images.yml publishes and image_map.json soken_image pins.

solana-build.note: arm64 host: runs under QEMU via colima. SOKEN_SOLANA_DIRECT=1 for dev only. 4.3.0 ships platform-tools v1.57 (rustc 1.95.0-sbpf). Digest verified 2026-10-09. cargo-audit and clippy are added via docker/solana-build/Dockerfile (ghcr.io/soken-ltd/solana-build).

sui-prove.note: docker/sui-prove (plan v4 07 prover integration). Extends sui-build with z3 (apt) and Boogie 3.4.3. NOTE: `sui move prove` availability in mainnet-v1.81.1 must be verified on x86 stand (`sui move prove --help`). If the subcommand is absent the prover step will produce not_run reason=prover_toolchain_missing for all Sui packages. Zero digest = not built; prove_image_for('sui') fails closed until pinned.

sui-build.note: docker/sui-build (plan v4 07 3, 3.1). Release tarball sha256-verified; framework at the tag commit. Runtime base Ubuntu 24.04 (binary needs glibc 2.38). Digest placeholder until the CI push.

ton-build.note: Pushed by the ton-e2e workflow (branch feat/ton-tier-a, commit 4b0d5af, run 38029714298) after the x86 adapter and supervisor e2e passed; build is not reproducible, so pin this digest, not the tag. Base node:22-bookworm-slim pinned by its amd64 digest in docker/ton-build/Dockerfile. Plan v4 06 section 4.2.

tron-analyze.note: Extends evm-analyze with TRON Slither shim (apply_tron_shim via make_plugin entry point, plan-v4 05 8.2 F23). Digest placeholder; replace after CI build. Build: docker build --build-context plugins=slither_plugins -f docker/tron-analyze/Dockerfile -t ghcr.io/soken-ltd/tron-analyze:0.1.0-dev .
